cohort: 49,253 women with children younger than 3 years of age in Latin America and the Caribbean
finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with higher odds of milk-based prelacteal feeding, and this association was stronger among women of lower socioeconomic status.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with significantly higher odds of milk-based prelacteal feeding in all countries.
country: Multiple countries in Latin America and the Caribbean
